_source: Special Pilot Abilities, Campaign Operations pp. 70-82: ids, names and point costs are the book's; summaries are our own words. Only abilities the app can play are listed.

abilities.name: Blood Stalker
abilities.summary: Picks one enemy as its quarry: -1 to hit it, +2 to hit anything else, until the quarry is destroyed or leaves the field.

abilities.name: Cluster Hitter
abilities.summary: +1 on the cluster roll for missiles, Ultra and rotary autocannons, and LB-X cluster shots.

abilities.name: Dodge
abilities.summary: Once a turn, when punched, kicked or swung at, rolls Piloting; if that roll beats the attack by more, the attack misses. One roll covers every physical attack that turn.

abilities.name: Eagle's Eyes
abilities.summary: Works like an active probe out to 1 hex (adds 1 hex to a real probe), and minefields are 2 harder to set off.

abilities.name: Fist Fire
abilities.summary: After a punch or arm weapon swing lands, fires one direct-fire energy or ballistic weapon in that arm at -1 to hit, into the same location. The arm needs all four actuators working.

abilities.name: Forward Observer
abilities.summary: Spots for indirect fire without the +1 on its own attacks.

abilities.name: Hopper
abilities.summary: Losing a leg isn't an automatic fall: a Piloting roll keeps the 'Mech standing, and if it falls anyway the MechWarrior gets -2 on the roll to avoid injury.

abilities.name: Hot Dog
abilities.summary: -1 to the rolls that avoid a heat shutdown or an ammo cook-off.

abilities.name: Human TRO
abilities.summary: Knows every design by heart: +1 on the roll for critical hits from its attacks.

abilities.name: Jumping Jack
abilities.summary: Jumping costs only +1 to its own attacks instead of +3.

abilities.name: Lucky
abilities.summary: Each point buys one reroll of a failed attack roll or piloting roll per battle; the second roll stands.

abilities.name: Maneuvering Ace
abilities.summary: A two-legged 'Mech can step sideways like a four-legged one; a four-legged 'Mech does it for 1 MP less.

abilities.name: Marksman
abilities.summary: Standing still, can aim one weapon at any location on a moving 'Mech as a targeting computer would (not the head). Only that weapon fires and no physical attack follows; with a working targeting computer the aimed shot gets -2.

abilities.name: Melee Specialist
abilities.summary: -1 to hit with physical attacks, and punches, kicks and melee weapons do 1 more damage.

abilities.name: Multi-Tasker
abilities.summary: Secondary targets cost 1 less to hit.

abilities.name: Oblique Attacker
abilities.summary: -1 to hit with indirect fire, and it can fire indirectly at a target no friend can see.

abilities.name: Range Master
abilities.summary: Swaps one range band's modifier with short range's: no penalty at that range, that penalty up close.

abilities.name: Sniper
abilities.summary: Range modifiers are halved: +1 at medium range, +2 at long.

abilities.name: Speed Demon
abilities.summary: +1 running MP, but a 'Mech that uses it can't attack that turn.

abilities.name: Tactical Genius
abilities.summary: Rerolls the side's Initiative when it loses; the second roll stands.

abilities.name: Terrain Master
abilities.summary: One specialty per purchase. Forest Ranger: woods cost 1 MP less, +1 to be hit in woods after walking. Mountaineer: rough, rubble and each level change cost 1 MP less, -1 on rubble rolls. Frogman: water deeper than depth 1 costs 1 MP less. Swamp Beast: -1 on mud rolls.

abilities.name: Weapon Specialist
abilities.summary: -2 to hit with one chosen kind of weapon.

abilities.name: Zweihander
abilities.summary: Punches or swings a hatchet or sword with both hands at a target in front: +1 damage per 10 tons (2 with active TSM), counting broken actuators in both arms. A hit risks a critical hit on the attacking arm (both arms when unarmed); a miss needs a Piloting roll like a missed kick.
